'''Halyna Oleksandrivna Puchkivska''' (June{{nbsp}}22, 1934{{snd}}September{{nbsp}}29, 2010) was a Soviet and Ukrainian physicist, a professor of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]] (since 1989), an Honored Worker of Science and Technology of Ukraine (2004), a pupil of the famous physicist [[Antonina Prikhot'ko]], a daughter of O.&nbsp;M. Puchkivsky (from the second marriage),<ref>{{cite web|url=http://uahistory.com/topics/famous_people/8509 |title=Олександр Пучківський |website=UAHistory |accessdate=12 April 2021}}</ref> and a younger sister of Nadiya Puchkivska.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.peoples.ru/medicine/ophthalmologist/nadejda_puchkovskaya/ |title=Надежда Пучковская - Nadejda Puchkovskaya |website=Люди |accessdate=12 April 2021}}</ref>
 
==Biography==
Puchkivska was born in [[Kyiv]].

In 1952, she graduated from the [[Taras Shevchenko National University]] of Kyiv, then worked as an engineer at the [[NASU Institute of Physics]]. In 1964, she defended her dissertation. From 1993 to 2010, after the death of M.&nbsp;T. Shpak, she headed the Department of Photoactivity of the Institute of Physics of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]].

Puchkivska developed a method for determining the parameters of hydrogen bonds in crystals. She participated in the creation and was the main organizer of the International School-Seminar, "Spectroscopy of Molecules and Crystals" (which is now named after her).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.iop.kiev.ua/ua/the-xxivth-galyna-puchkovska-international-school-seminar-spectroscopy-of-molecules-and-crystals/ |title=The 25th Galyna Puchkovska International School-Seminar "Spectroscopy of Molecules and Crystals" |website= Institute of Physics of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine |accessdate=12 April 2021}}</ref>

The main works of Puchkivska are devoted to the problems of spectroscopy of molecules and crystals (about 300 works).

She died in Kyiv on September 29, 2010, and was buried in Lukianivske Cemetery next to her father.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/197221736 |title=Galina Alekandrovna Puchkovskaya |website=Find A Grave |accessdate=12 April 2021}}</ref>

==Awards and titles==
*[[Jubilee Medal "In Commemoration of the 100th Anniversary of the Birth of Vladimir Ilyich Lenin"]]: "For Valiant Labour" (1970).
*[[State Prize of Ukraine in Science and Technology]] (1984).
*Corresponding Member of the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts|European Academy of Sciences]], Arts and Literature (Paris).
*Prize of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]] named after [[Antonina Prikhot'ko]] (2006).<ref>{{cite web
 |url          =http://www.nas.gov.ua/UA/Competition/Pages/winners.aspx?CompetitionID=062&Year=2006

 |accessdate =12 April 2021
}}</ref>

==Selected scientific works==
*IR spectroscopy of molecular crystals with hydrogen bonds, Kyiv, 1989 (co-author) 
*Optical manifestations of conformational mobility of H-alkanoates of cholesterol (in Russian) (co-author)
